title: 祭赛国扫宝塔
subtitle: 先找证据，不让误会蒙尘
origin: 《西游记》第六十二至六十三回（低龄温和改编）

moral.zh: 事情出了问题，不要急着责怪谁；一起寻找证据、听完原因，才能公平解决。
moral.en: When something goes wrong, look for evidence and hear the full story before blaming anyone.

pages.zh: 祭赛国宝塔失去光彩，守塔僧人被误会没有认真看护。
pages.en: The pagoda of Jisai Kingdom lost its glow, and the caretakers were blamed for not watching it well.
pages.prompt: Full team arrives at a tall safe pagoda with dim upper windows while worried but calm caretakers hold brooms; no punishment, no text in image.

pages.zh: 唐僧说：“先别下结论。我们从第一层开始，一边扫塔，一边找线索。”
pages.en: Tang Seng said, “Let us not decide too quickly. We can clean each floor and look for clues.”
pages.prompt: Tang Seng organizes team and caretakers with brooms, baskets, and lanterns at the first pagoda floor; methodical friendly mood, no text in image.

pages.zh: 灰尘里有蓝色水珠、彩色羽毛，还有一条通往塔顶的湿脚印。
pages.en: In the dust they found blue droplets, a colorful feather, and damp footprints leading upward.
pages.prompt: Close floor-level view of blue droplets, one colorful feather, and rounded wet footprints beside a broom; Wukong observes with magnifier-like crystal, no text in image.

pages.zh: 塔顶宝珠不见了，窗外却有一道柔光，一直连向碧波潭。
pages.en: The tower pearl was gone, but a soft trail of light stretched from the window toward Blue-Wave Lake.
pages.prompt: Team at a broad safe tower balcony sees an empty pearl stand and a gentle light trail across the landscape toward a blue lake; no falling risk, no text in image.

pages.zh: 湖边，一只九羽彩鸟正用宝珠照亮刚孵化的小鸟。它说自己只是借一晚。
pages.en: By the lake, a nine-feathered bird used the pearl to warm newly hatched chicks. It said it meant to borrow it for one night.
pages.prompt: Friendly adult bird with one head and nine fan-like colorful tail feathers shelters fluffy chicks beside the glowing pearl; team approaches gently, no scary creature, no text in image.

pages.zh: 悟空指出，没留口信的“借用”让别人受了委屈。彩鸟低头向守塔人道歉。
pages.en: Wukong explained that borrowing without a message had caused others to be blamed. The bird apologized to the caretakers.
pages.prompt: Wukong calmly explains while the colorful bird bows to two caretakers; pearl rests safely on a cushion, open lakeside scene, no text in image.

pages.zh: 大家用镜片和灯罩给鸟巢做了新暖灯，彩鸟把宝珠送回塔顶。
pages.en: Together they made a new warm lamp with mirrors and a cover, and the bird returned the pearl to the tower.
pages.prompt: Team, caretakers, and bird assemble a safe enclosed glowing lamp near the nest using rounded mirrors; cooperative scene, no fire, no text in image.

pages.zh: 宝塔再次发光，守塔人的误会也解开了。扫净的每一层都亮堂堂。
pages.en: The pagoda shone again, and the caretakers' names were cleared. Every freshly swept floor gleamed.
pages.prompt: Bright restored pagoda at dusk with team, caretakers, and bird waving below; clean windows glow softly, celebratory but calm, no text in image.
